title: Career Roadmap: Scientist
summary: Conduct scientific research, develop and test hypotheses, analyse experimental or computational data, and contribute to discoveries, innovations and scientific publications in fields such as Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biotechnology or Life Sciences.

facts.Current degree: Integrated / Dual-Degree Programmes (BS-MS, B.Tech+M.Tech, B.Sc-M.Sc, BA-MA)
facts.Course: Integrated M.Sc (Physics / Chemistry / Maths / Biotech / Life Sciences)

blocks.text: Conduct scientific research, develop and test hypotheses, analyse experimental or computational data, and contribute to discoveries, innovations and scientific publications in fields such as Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biotechnology or Life Sciences.

rows.text: Science stream with subjects relevant to the intended specialization
Relevant B.Sc., BS or an eligible integrated science programme
Integrated M.Sc. or a relevant M.Sc. degree
Ph.D. for many independent scientist and advanced R&D positions

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Microbiology and Life Sciences.
Admission requirements vary by institution and programme. Check eligibility, entrance examinations and subject prerequisites before applying.

blocks.label: Scientific Thinking
blocks.text: Hypothesis formulation, critical thinking and problem-solving.

blocks.label: Research Methods
blocks.text: Experimental design, laboratory procedures or computational modelling.

blocks.label: Data Analysis
blocks.text: Statistics, Excel, Python or R, and scientific visualisation.

blocks.label: Technical Expertise
blocks.text: Instrumentation, laboratory techniques or domain-specific software.

blocks.label: Research Communication
blocks.text: Scientific writing, presentations, literature reviews and research ethics.

items.text: Conduct a literature review on a current scientific question.
Complete a supervised experimental or computational research project.
Analyse a dataset and document reproducible methods.
Prepare a research poster or conference presentation.
Write a report describing the methodology, results, limitations and conclusions.

blocks.text: Choose projects appropriate to the selected discipline and available facilities.
Seek research internships or project placements at:

items.text: CSIR laboratories and other national research institutions.
Environmental, materials-science and industrial research organisations.

blocks.text: Check individual programmes for eligibility, application deadlines and whether prior research experience is required.

items.text: Python or R for scientific computing.
Laboratory safety and good laboratory practices.
Specialized instrumentation, simulation or bioinformatics tools, depending on the discipline.

blocks.text: Hands-on research and strong subject knowledge are generally more valuable than unrelated certificates.
Senior Scientist → Principal Scientist / Research Lead
Formal scientist positions may require a Ph.D., relevant experience or competitive recruitment examinations. An integrated M.Sc. alone does not guarantee eligibility for every scientist post.

items.text: Quality Control or Quality Assurance Analyst
Scientific Research Officer, subject to recruitment requirements

rows.text: Choose a specialization, strengthen core concepts and review recent research papers.
Complete a small supervised research project and learn appropriate analysis tools.
Prepare a research CV, project report and statement of interest; apply for suitable research internships.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Strong subject fundamentals, research experience, data-analysis skills, scientific communication and a documented project portfolio, supported by the qualifications required for the intended scientist position.
